teaser: What never scaled is on-demand expertise: the before and after the meeting. Agents can now carry them, for any expert, anywhere.
core_idea: Many old jobs never scaled because on-demand expertise depended on weeks of context gathering before the meeting and writing up after it, which experts dislike and are not hired for; agents can now carry both phases, as the clinic's support staff do for a specialist, so historians, librarians, consultants and others can work for any project, anywhere, even part-time, and service businesses can grow with judgement rather than hours.

quotes.text: What is a consultant? Somebody who has skills the team does not have.
